note: YWHAZ p.Ser230Trp causes Popov-Chang syndrome with CFC-like features via RAS-ERK pathway activation, making the evaluation of its specific cardiac profile vs. classical CFC highly plausible.

evidence.text: The S230W variant in YWHAZ acts as a gain-of-function mutation in the RAS-ERK pathway and was identified in individuals with phenotypes consistent with cardiofaciocutaneous (CFC) syndrome, a condition characterized by congenital heart defects.

source.title: A YWHAZ Variant Associated With Cardiofaciocutaneous ...
source.quote: We recently identified novel variants in YWHAZ, a 14-3-3 family member, in individuals with a phenotype consistent with CFC that may potentially be deleterious and disease-causing. In the current study, we take advantage of the vertebrate model Xenopus laevis to analyze the functional consequence of a particular YWHAZ variant, S230W, and investigate the molecular mechanisms underlying its activity.
